result.detail: No formal_spec file is submitted, so the formal.run and formal.cover requirements do not apply to this result. The interface spec still asks for a formal proof (section 8), so a follow-up formal task at ADDR_WIDTH 4 and 8 should be scheduled. The testbench is one top module with two DUT lanes, because simulator.run takes one top. Stimulus changes on the falling edge. The irq monitor samples on the rising edge, before the nonblocking updates, so rise_edge records the edge after which irq first went high. If a timing check fails, look first at the testbench's edge arithmetic in run_all as well as at the RTL. I did not run anything; every result has to come from the platform's runs.
